notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that has haste.
Yurlok does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the nontoken creature with haste by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking the nontoken creature with haste.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Yurlok.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to your next step and/or phase, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to the amount of unspent mana they have.
